messages.subject: [pomp-announce] pomp version 0.43-4 released
messages.body_plain:
Dear pomp users,

The source code of pomp version 0.43-4 is now on CRAN.  Binaries should become available on the mirrors over the next few days.  This is a bug fix release.

Happy pomping!

Aaron

--
Aaron A. King, Ph.D.
Ecology & Evolutionary Biology
Mathematics
Center for the Study of Complex Systems
University of Michigan
